english.title: The Skybreaker Bulwark
english.objective: Reclaim the Skybreaker Bulwark from Zaal Stormshield at the Shrine of Akir.
english.detail:
I am all that remains of the line of Skybreakers here on Zephras Isle. The rest were murdered by the Al'Aketh.

The only thing that outweighs my sorrow is my shame. My family's ancestral shield--the Skybreaker Bulwark--is now in the hands of a cultist named Zaal Stormshield. Family lore holds no harm may befall a worthy wielder of this shield.

Zaal is not worthy, of that I am sure. Find this man at the Shrine of Akir and reclaim my shield from him. Do this and I will teach you the Skybreaker Defense.
english.progress: <Seena nods curtly at you.>
english.complete:
You have done what I could not and restored my family honor. For this, I will bestow a gift that few on Zephras are worthy to receive. I will teach out the secrets of the Skybreaker Defense.

Also, you will need a shield to put what I have to teach you into practice. Please, take this one. I have little use for it now that the Skybreaker Bulwark has been returned to me.

Banu'Adoraah, friend.

english.title: The Great Ursera Spirit
english.objective: Speak with Urs'endris near the falls northeast of Valanaar.
english.detail:
Greetings, <Name>. You have progressed in your druidic studies far enough that I think it is time for you to meet one of the great spirits that reside here on Zephras. Urs'endris is a wise and noble spirit, who has taught druids how to take on the ursera shape for generations. Unfortunately his domain has begun to wither and fall into the sky like many other areas of Zephras.

To find him, travel northeast near the waterfall in the shadow of the Shrine of Akir. He should be able to instruct you further.
english.complete: So, you wish to embrace the way of the claw, child? Very well. Let us speak.

english.title: Taming the Beast
english.objective: Report to Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar.
english.detail:
Now that you've gained a level of comfort in the wilds of the highlands, I believe it is time for you to seek your very own animal companion.

Go to the port of Valanaar to the southeast, and speak with Quel'ana Quickgale there. He will instruct you in the art of beast taming.
english.complete: I am most glad that you came. Come, let us begin.

english.title: Taming the Beast
english.objective: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Vuldren Alpha in the Gustberry Lowlands. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar.
english.detail:
You've returned triumphant from taming two beasts. It's time now for your last trial. The winds of Zephras whisper of greater challenges ahead. 

Take this Taming Rod and journey to the Gustberry Lowlands. There, tame a Vuldren Alpha and prove your mastery. 

Complete this lesson and you'll be ready to learn the deeper ways of the hunter.
english.progress: You will learn, <name>, and one day you will be a great <class>.
english.complete:
Excellent, <name>! You are quite a fast learner. Now that you know the basics, I can teach you how to forge a lasting bond with an animal companion.

Go with this knowledge and thrive. Be the <class> that Zephras Isle needs you to be.

english.title: Training the Beast
english.objective: Speak to Quel'dora Quickgale in Valanaar.
english.detail:
You now have the power to tame a pet, but you must also gain the skills to train it. For this, there is none better than my sister, Quel'dora. She will give you the ability to train your new pet. 

Go with the winds, young <Class>.
english.complete:
A fledgling <class>, I see. Yes, I can bestow you with the skills you need to train and guide your pet. Not only will you be able to teach your pet new abilities, you will now be able to feed your pet, as well as revive it, should it fall in battle.

Remember, <name>, always respect the balance and live in awe of nature around you. Now, go forth. We shall speak again, at a later date.

english.title: The Fate of Zephras
english.objective: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
english.detail:
Ansirem has told me much of the elemental lords and I am afraid that we have good reason to fear Al'Akir now that the wards that have hidden Zephras are down. If the Windlord chooses to attack us, we stand no chance to defend ourselves while we are here in his domain.

High Elder Shadowsong needs to know of the danger we are in, and more importantly, what our intentions are for our mission to Azeroth. We will find the means to save our home. I swear it.
english.complete:
<Talaanis Shadowsong listens intently as you tell him of what transpired above the Shrine of Akir, and of Elaadrin's plan to leave Zephras Isle.>

I need to reflect on this further, but looking at the upside, we have rid ourselves of Lorthuna and deprived the cult of their leader. Our home has not been invaded yet, and on the timeline of elemental demigods, it could be years... decades even, before Al'Akir deigns to turn his attention to us.

There is much to fear now, but much to celebrate as well.

english.title: Meddlesome Mages
english.objective: Slay 6 High Order Apprentices in Shen'dar Highlands.
english.detail:
Be warned, members of the High Order have been seen in the vicinity of the standing stones north of the village. We have warned them time and again to not meddle at our sacred sites, but they are growing more bold in pushing us. Prove your resolve to us by going to the standing stones and dispersing them.

I am loathe to condone outright bloodshed, but do what you must to drive them off. Return to me when it's done.
english.complete:
Direct conflict with our shen'dorei brothers and sisters only weakens us as a people, but decisive action must at times be taken to prevent greater tragedy.

The mages of the High Order have zero regard for the consequences of their magical meddling. The forces that bind our island are fragile and vulnerable and all it could take is one thoughtless action to destroy our home.

english.title: A Magical Affront
english.objective: Slay 6 Windshaper Novice Seers in Shen'dar Highlands.
english.detail:
The recent emergence of the leylines on the surface of Zephras has been profound for our order. We have more direct and tangible access to the energies that permeate this place and it has increased our understanding of said magic greatly.

The Windshapers, however, view these emergences as scars on the land that must be "healed". This is an affront to our order and is something we simply cannot abide.

Go to the leyline in the forest to the southwest and drive off the Windshapers you find there.
english.complete:
Sometimes I find it hard to distinguish between the blind zealotry of the Al'Aketh cult, and the stubborn refusal of the Windshapers to change.

If they truly believed the winds would guide us, they should be sensing the direction the winds are blowing and flow with them rather than against them.

english.title: The Anchors of Zephras
english.objective: Speak with Halaan Hawk-Eye and borrow his gift to view the anchor pylon in the distance.
english.detail:
Greetings, young <Name>. I oftentimes come here to look upon the ancient anchor pylon. Gifts from the spirits of the winds, they bind and sustain our island. Of late however, their magic has grown unstable and inconsistent.

They suffer no distress I can see. Their splendor has not changed.

If you'd like, I can lend you my gift to look upon them yourself.
english.progress:
My gift is simple, and mundane. I cannot peer between worlds such as those with the skysight, nor can I draw upon the magic of the ley lines beneath Zephras like others can. But a gift it remains and I am grateful to have it.

Appreciation of what you have is the key to happiness. Yearning for what you may have, or what you have lost, only leads to despair.
english.complete: Thank you for taking a moment to share this with me. I will continue to watch over the grove, and ponder on the state of our homeland.

english.title: Unnerving Silence
english.objective: Find and speak with Elegael Thornpaw in the northeastern part of Shadowgale Forest.
english.detail:
A moment if you will, <Name>. Are you headed towards Shadowgale Forest? There is a druid conclave there in a cave to the northeast. I have been waiting on word from them but their correspondence is long overdue.

With Ban'aethall in ruins and all the unrest lately I worry something dire may have happened. Please, if you are able, go seek out Elegael Thornpaw and put my mind at ease.
english.complete:
Thank goodness our message got to Lotheluum. Wait, where are the rest of the reinforcements? Surely it is not just you they sent?

<Elegael pales as you relay your conversation with Lotheluum.>

So the message did not get through. We are in dire straights indeed then.

It seems we must handle this on our own. Time is of the essence.

english.title: Tears of the Lady
english.objective: Collect 8 Lady's Tear Moss.
english.detail:
If we are to save my fellows in the Nightclaw Den, I am going to need some ingredients for a poultice. The first and most important is a spindly moss called Lady's Tear. It typically grows on the base of the trees here in Shadowgale.

This moss secretes a sticky substance that acts as an antiseptic and is perfect for binding open wounds. I have gathered what little I can reach but I know there is more in this forest.

Go and be swift. We are going to need a lot if the injured I left behind still live.
english.progress: Have you found the Lady's Tear?
english.complete:
<Elegael takes the sticky mound of moss from you with a weak smile.>

Thank you, <name>, you have done well. This is exactly what we need.

english.title: Feathers for Binding
english.objective: Collect 20 feathers from the Shadowgale Shrieklings in Shadowgale Forest.
english.detail:
The other ingredient I need for the poultice is feathers from the Shadowgale shrieklings that roam this forest. In their juvenile form, the shrieklings have insulative feathers which would be ideal to put over the moss. These feathers will prevent the antiseptic sap from drying out and will provide at least some protection against the elements.

Be warned, the shrieklings are normally docile but they have been incredibly hostile of late. Their large talons can easily disembowel you if you aren't careful.
english.progress: It deeply saddens me to ask you to kill the young shrieklings, but with the rise in their aggression it is for the best. We can only handle so many emergencies at a time.
english.complete: Thank you for these. I will be sure to use every feather so their sacrifice will not be in vain.

english.title: Unwanted and Unworthy
english.objective: Collect 10 Bloodied Heirlooms from Al'Aketh Footsoldiers and Al'Aketh Stormchasers in the Shadowgale Forest.
english.detail:
The Al'Aketh Cultists ambushed us with no warning, though their motives remain a mystery to me. I knew these cultists had clouds between their ears, but I never imagined they would upset the delicate balance here on Zephras with such brutality. Go, slay as many as you can and take their heirlooms if they wear any.

<Elegael spits.>

These storm-cursed cultists don't deserve to be called shen'dorei. The beasts of the forest can have their bodies. Their ashes don't deserve the winds.
english.progress: I will make the cult pay for every drop of druid blood they have spilled this day.
english.complete:
<Elegael looks down at the collection of bloodied heirlooms with distress.>

So many young lives with so much potential now gone forever. Thank you for returning these, <class>.

I will hold onto them for safe keeping until I am able to take them to the High Elder. There they can go back into the collection and await the next and perhaps more worthy generation to come of age.

english.title: The Ties That Bind
english.objective: Kill Commander Haalien and bring his head to Elegael Thornpaw in the Shadowgale Forest.
english.detail:
The reason for cultists' presence here still baffles me, but I smell a familiar scent over the bloodshed.

One of our circle druids, Haalien, disappeared months back. It appears he's thrown his sorry hide in with the cultists.

Show him what happens when he spills the blood of his kin! Take his head and return it to me.
english.progress: Are our brethren's lives truly worth so little to you, Haalien?
english.complete:
<Elegael grimaces at the severed head, but nods curtly.>

Thank you, <name>. No matter how much rage I have within me, it would have been difficult to strike down my own cousin.

Do not mourn for him. His ignorance and malice has killed many innocents this day.

english.title: The Wounds of Betrayal
english.objective: Enter the Nightfang Den and heal 7 druids and find Jorel Windsinger in Shadowgale Forest.
english.detail:
I have finished the poultices. Quickly, take them to the druids in the cave, north just across the clearing. I know my brethren are in much more dire condition than I. They are likely too injured to heal their own wounds. There are so few of us shen'dorei druids that every life is precious.

Before you go, I have a selfish request. My mate, Jorel Windsinger was in dire condition when I left. Please, see to his wounds if he still lives.
english.progress: <class>! You have returned. Were you able to reach my brothers and sisters? Did you find Jorel?
english.complete:
<Elegael's face pales as you relay the fate of Jorel and the condition of the rest of the druids.>

No... no! This is far worse than I had--

<Elegael chokes back a sob, and grits her teeth letting out a pained snarl.>

They will pay. They will ALL pay. Anyone who allies with the Al'aketh will feel my wrath! This I swear.

english.title: Ripped Missive
english.objective: Bring the Ripped Missive to Elegael Thornpaw in the Shadowgale Forest.
english.detail: <Tucked behind one of Haalien's bracers is a note that's been slightly torn and bloodstained in your fight. It looks like it contains useful information about the cultist motivations for the attack on the druid den. Elegael would be interested in this intel.>
english.complete:
They were here for the pylon? But to what end? We were not the original reason for their attack?

<Elegael trails off shaking with rage as she reads.>

They murdered my people because we were an inconvenience! I shall tear apart every cultist with my fangs! I will make sure none leave this place with their lives.

Go, swiftly! If the orders truly originated in Valanaar, it means it is likely a traitor hiding there. Give the missive to Lotheluum in Valannar and tell him what has transpired.

english.title: The Fate of the Den
english.objective: Give the missive to Lotheluum in Valanaar and tell him what has transpired.
english.detail:
It would appear that there is a correspondent hiding somewhere in Valanaar feeding information to the cult. I am clearly in no shape to make the journey, but Lotheluum needs to know what transpired here.

He should also know the fate of those who are no longer with us. Thanks to your help I think we can handle the rest of the situation from here, though the damage has been done.

Please go swiftly, <Name>. I hope our paths will cross again someday. Until then, I have cultists to slay.
english.complete:
<Lotheluum wears a look of genuine terror as you recount the events from the druid den.>

I--I'm sorry, <name>. I need just a moment. There are no words I possess that can describe the loss.

This is grave news indeed. If this missive is not fabricated, then we indeed have at best an accomplice and at worst a traitor here in Valanaar. I will take this to the High Elder immediately! I will not let my fellows sacrifice be in vain.

english.title: A Sacrifice in Vain
english.objective: Speak with Elegael Thornpaw in the northeastern part of Shadowgale Forest.
english.detail:
Thank goodness our message got to Lotheluum. Wait, where are the rest of the reinforcements? Surely it is not just you they sent?

<Elegael pales as you explain yourself.>

So the message did not get to Valanaar. We are in dire straits indeed then.

<Elegael sighs deeply then looks resolute.>

Then we must handle this on our own. Time is of the essence.
english.complete:
The Al'aketh Cultists ambushed us with little to no warning. Many inside my den lay wounded or dying. I had attempted to send a message to Valanaar but it appears my efforts were in vain.

Please, if you have come here I beg for your help. I don't know how much longer my fellows will be able to survive this onslaught.

english.title: The Cult's True Plans
english.objective: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong and observe the conversation.
english.detail:
The turncoat clearly was afraid of what the cult had planned, enough so to defect and seek our aid. It's truly unfortunate that he is dead and took his secrets to the grave with him.

We must discuss this further to determine our next steps.
english.progress: That turncoat risked everything to escape the cult and bring us this crystal...
english.complete:
We could try and send peacekeepers to directly engage the cult forces, but we would not fare well against them in open battle.

We are going to need a different approach.

english.title: Strength and Mercy
english.objective: Find and kill Ur'endra in the Shen'dar Highlands.
english.detail:
You have come to me in hopes of learning to take a shape of strength. I have a task for you, though it lies heavy on my heart.

My mate, Ur'endra, has lost herself to madness and has begun to attack her own kin. Without the magic of the winds, many creatures have begun to lose themselves... Ur'endra included. She makes her lair in a cave to the west of here, in the bluffs along the border between the Shen'dar Highlands and the Gustberry Lowlands.

End her suffering and I shall grant you my blessing.
english.progress: What I ask of you is no easy task. Take heart in your courage and return to me when the deed is done.
english.complete:
The agony I feel over her loss is immeasurable, but it is what is necessary for the balance. You have demonstrated a resolve to persevere, even when a terrible price is asked.

You have done well, <class>. I shall grant you the blessing to take on the shape of my kin. Be a beacon for those that lack the strength to persevere and a defender of those in need.

Go now, and embrace the way of the claw, child.

english.title: Aid For The Refugees
english.objective: Collect 8 Abandoned Belongings from the ruins of Ban'aethal.
english.detail:
You look like a capable adventurer. Do you happen to be headed towards Shadowgale Forest? Ban'aethal lies deep in the forest; that's where we're all from.

<Ealaane gestures to the other refugees.>

We've recently had to evacuate Ban'aethal, as it began to fall into the sky. It was sudden and in the middle of the night. If you are headed that way, would you please look for any belongings left behind? The forest and village are far too dangerous for us to return to now.
english.progress: So many of us left with nothing more than the clothes on our backs. Any belongings you might recover would be cherished.
english.complete: Thank you, <class>, you have done a great kindness to us refugees this day. I will make sure to return these to their owners. At least it gives us a place to start over from.

english.title: The Fate of a Loved One
english.objective: Find Resaan in the Ruins of Ban'aethal.
english.detail:
If you are traveling to Ban'aethal, I have a selfish request. My love, Resaan... I believe is no longer a part of this world. He had tried to go back to get supplies even though I begged him to stay. It has been over a week already and I fear the worst.

Please, if you find him, bring him home. If he has perished then I beg you to please bring me his heirloom.
english.progress: Have you any news of Resaan? Please, <class>, the wait is hard to endure after everything that has happened.
english.complete:
<Ealaane's eyes well with tears.>

Oh, Resaan my love. What will become of us now? There was so much... it feels as if our lives together had just started.

Thank you, <class>. The world is cruel to take both my home and my love from me. At least his heirloom will give me some closure.

english.title: The Magical City of Dalaran
english.objective: Take the skycutter ship from Zephras Isle to Dalaran City and speak with Danaaris Stargale when you arrive.
english.detail:
I had intended to be the first of us to step foot onto Azeroth, but recent events with the cult have changed my plans. As a result, I will be remaining here in Valanaar for a time. Fret not though, we have several mages awaiting our people's arrival in Dalaran. I'd encourage you to explore Azeroth while we set our affairs in order here. We will call upon agents such as yourself when you are needed.

When you are ready, please proceed to the dock just outside this lodge and board the skycutter ship there.
english.complete:
Ah, you've made it. Wonderful. It's going to take us some time to get ourselves established here, so you may want to take some time to explore the city. Be warned however, try not to venture too far from the safety of the city proper.  

As idyllic as this new land appears, it can be extremely dangerous to wander outside of Dalaran without appropriate preparation and experience.

english.title: Welcome to Azeroth
english.objective: Take the Skyborne Portal to Stormwind and report to Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind Keep.
english.detail:
It's a big world down here, and we need our people to start branching out to explore it. That's where you come in.

The Kirin Tor is a member of an "Alliance" of like-minded nations. The de-facto heart of this alliance is the city of Stormwind to the south. Elaadrin has asked me to find someone to travel to Stormwind and meet with the regent lord there, a human named Bolvar Fordragon.

When you are ready, the Kirin Tor mages have set up a special portal for the High Order to use to access Stormwind.
english.complete:
Well met, <class>. I am Bolvar Fordragon, regent to the throne of Stormwind.

A Kirin Tor messenger told me to expect an emissary from the High Order, and here you stand. It's been some time since a high elf has stood in this throne room, but I am glad to accept you now as a guest.

On behalf of the King, I welcome you to Stormwind and give you leave to travel freely through alliance lands. Welcome to Azeroth, Skyborne.

english.title: Taming the Beast
english.objective:
Use the Taming Rod to tame a Windsong Crawler found near bodies of water. 
Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar.
english.detail:
Every hunter begins by learning the bond between beast and master. This is your first challenge. In time, you'll tame creatures from every corner of the world, but for now, start with our rivers and lakes on Zephras. 

Take this Taming Rod and seek out a Windsong Crawler.

Show that you can earn its trust, and begin your path toward true mastery.
english.progress: You will learn, <name>, and one day you will be a great <class>.
english.complete: Well tamed, <name>! You are becoming adept already.

english.title: Taming the Beast
english.objective:
Use the Taming Rod to tame an Ornery Galestrider in the Gustberry Lowlands. 
Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar.
english.detail:
You've proven you can tame the river's crawler. Now it's time to test your skill on open ground. The plains of Zephras echo with the cries of the galestrider, a proud, winged hunter that runs like the wind.

Take this Taming Rod and seek one out. Travel to the lowlands and earn its trust.

Show you're ready for the trials yet to come.
english.progress: You will learn, <name>, and one day you will be a great <class>.
english.complete: You're back already! Impressive speed, <name>!

english.title: The Earthen Ring
english.objective: Take the skycutter ship from Zephras Isle to Mulgore and speak with Alaana Stormwalker when you arrive.
english.detail:
The recent events with the cult have delayed my plans to travel to Azeroth and I must remain here in Valanaar for a time. You and a handful of other Windshapers will be our vanguard instead. Alaana Stormwalker will be waiting to receive our Windshapers upon arrival in Mulgore, and I'd encourage you to explore Azeroth while we finish our business here. We will join you soon.

When you are ready, please proceed to the dock just outside this lodge and board the skycutter ship there. 

Banu-Alah, <Name>.
english.complete:
More adventurers from Zephras, I see. Wonderful. The winds surely favor us! It's going to take us some time to get ourselves established here, so you may want to take some time to explore this new land.

Azeroth is an exciting new world, but it's also a dangerous world. You'd do well to prepare yourself for this new adventure by familiarizing yourself with the lands nearby.

english.title: Welcome to Azeroth
english.objective: Travel to Orgrimmar and speak with Thrall in the Valley of Wisdom.
english.detail:
It's a big world down here, and our new allies are the key to our survival.

The Earthen Ring is a member of the "Horde", a proud collection of like-minded peoples. The nearby city of Thunder Bluff is a part of the Horde, and further to the east lies the capital of Orgrimmar.

Seek out the flight master in the center of Thunder Bluff. They will fly you to Orgrimmar where you will make contact with the Horde warchief--Thrall, on behalf of the Windshapers. Winds guide you, <Name>.
english.complete:
Lok-tar, <class>. I am Thrall, Warchief of the Horde.

An Earthen Ring messenger told me to expect members of the Windshapers, and here you are. I'd not have expected to see a high elf standing before me here in Orgrimmar, but the horde will welcome you as our guest all the same.

You have my blessing to travel through horde lands. Go with honor, Windshaper.

english.title: The Great Outdoors
english.objective: Sit near Raan's Basic Campfire and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.
english.detail:
Greetings, <Class>. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.
english.progress: Having the skills needed to survive the outdoors are critical. A well-rested and well-prepared adventurer has a much higher chance of surviving this lifestyle.
english.complete: So now that we've learned the basics, why don't you go and learn a tradeskill from the trainers in the village nearby. They will also teach you how to create a camp fixture suitable to your new profession.

english.title: The Adventurer
english.objective: Speak to Raan Wildwind near Shen'dar Village.
english.detail:
More and more adventurers like yourself have been seeking glory and fortune outside of the safety of Thendal Grove. There's one such adventurer who has made a camp outside of Shen'dar Village, along the road leading southwest out of Thendal Grove.

Seek him out and see what you can learn from him that may help you in your own travels.
english.complete: Well met!

english.title: Camping 101: Cooking
english.objective: Speak with Zerril Softbreeze in Shen'dar Village to learn to become a cook.
english.detail:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, <Class>. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.
english.progress: A good campfire is the foundation to any good camp.
english.complete:
With this, you'll be able to set up a camp anywhere out in the wilderness. What you've learned is just the basics, so you won't be able to place too many furnishings around it.

Raise your cooking skill and you might just be able to learn to make even bigger fires.

You can also learn the basics of furnishing your campsites from other tradeskill trainers if you're savvy in their skills.

english.title: Call of Fire
english.objective: Bring the Torch of Dormant Flame to Olariaan Swiftburn at the Shrine of Flames in the Gustberry Lowlands.
english.detail:
Even though we are in the realm of skywall, this is still the elemental plane. The spirits of all four elements speak to us, if we deign to listen. One among us Windshapers is in particular attunement with the element of fire. A shen'dorei by the name of Olariaan Swiftburn.

Bring this to him at the Shrine of Flames in the Gustberry Lowlands. You'll find it tucked away along the edge of the island, west of Valanaar.
english.progress: Yes, <name>? What do you have there?
english.complete: So you've brought the torch. Yes, young <class>, I can teach you to heed the call of fire. It will not be easy, but nothing that we do in this realm is ever easy.

english.title: Call of Fire
english.objective: Slay Skypriest Faladiel in the Gustberry Lowlands and collect Faladiel's Heart.
english.detail:
There is an Al'Aketh Skypriest called Faladiel. He was once a caller of the flame and a stalwart Windshaper. Like so many Al'Aketh, he mortgaged his loyalty for power and his hands are now stained with the blood of  his former brothers and sisters.

You will find Skypriest Faladiel at the farm to the northeast past Valanaar, just to the south of the Shrine of Akir. Kill the betrayer. Bring me his heart. It is a gruesome task, but it is needed for the ritual we are to perform.
english.progress: The heart of a betrayer is a powerful reagent. The flames will eagerly accept such an offering and burn more intensely as it is consumed.
english.complete:
The Windshapers do not forget, and blood is always paid with blood. It pleases me that you were able to deliver this final, painful reminder of our creed to this traitor.

This heart will not be all that feeds the flames today, however. There is one other task that needs to done.

english.title: Call of Fire
english.objective: Find the home of Kuramaa in the Shen'dar Highlands, and defeat the spirit in combat. Bring Kuramaa's Mask to Olariaan Swiftburn in the Gustberry Lowlands when you are victorious.
english.detail:
The residents of the Shen'dar Highlands speak of an ancient forest sprite called Kuramaa. They say it lives inside of a twisted stump at the summit of a hill near the highlands Anchor Pylon.

Go to the highlands and find this stump. Rap your fist upon the bark and Kuramaa will appear. Best the spirit in combat, and bring me its wooden mask.

Be warned however, this entity will be exceptionally resistant to much of your magic. Only the touch of flame will lay low the spirit.
english.progress: The spirit of Kuramaa is eternal, and it will manifest again when it is needed. It's mask is a source of great power, and will prove invaluable to the ritual we must complete.
english.complete: We now have what we need. We will light the eternal flame and commune with the spirits of fire.

english.title: Call of Fire
english.objective:
Wait for Olariaan to begin the ritual at the Brazier of Offering and follow his instructions.

You must deliver the Eternal Flame to Valanaar before the timer runs out.
english.detail:
Now we will perform the ritual. 

I will place the materials onto the altar and call forth the spirits of flame. If the offering is accepted, they will appear and light the Eternal Flame. You will then hold your torch forth and capture the flame.

Carry the lit torch to Valanaar and place it in the Brazier of Eternal Flames. You must do so quickly, for the flames of the Firelands are quick to dissipate here in Skywall.
english.progress: You have done well to come this far. You do the Windshapers honor, <name>.
english.complete:
It is done. The Eternal Flame burns once again.

Your trial is now complete. I am pleased to present you with your Fire Totem. Use this icon of power well in your travels, <name>. 

Just remember, the power of the elemental plane serves those that respect it, and consumes those who do not. This is our way.

english.title: Camping 101: Alchemy
english.objective: Speak with Nyassa Swiftdraught in Shen'dar Village to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
english.detail:
So, you chose to cook up brews and potions as an Alchemist. I'm sure that'll come in handy in your travels.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Mana Well for your camp. Build one of these and all of the healers and spellcaster types will come running to get a refreshing taste.
english.progress: Yes, I can teach you.
english.complete:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Mana Well. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.

I reckon I know someone that can help with that by teaching you how to craft a Sharpening Wheel. Bring one of these out at your camp and all the warriors and rogues in the area will be lining up to hone their weapons.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a First Aid Kit for your camp. Injuries are a reality in the world of adventuring and offering some much-needed healing at your camp could even save lives.

english.detail:
You might not think so, but your skill as a fisherman can actually come in handy at camp.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Fish Bowl for your camp. You can use this fixture to help provide a bit of joy to yourself and your fellow adventurers. A happy adventurer is a strong adventurer and I'm sure your combat capabilities will reflect that.

english.objective: Speak with Syriel Nightrain in Valanaar to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
english.detail:
Looks to me like you've gained some skill in herbalism. Picking flowers isn't just for dilly-dallying, you know. It can be useful... and profitable.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Incense Candle for your camp. High spirits are a key component to keeping healers and spellcasters in the fight, and an Incense Candle can provide a boost that magic users will surely appreciate.

english.detail:
You've become a leatherworker. Good for you, <Class>. I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to make yourself a tent that will keep you cool on hot days, and dry on rainy days.

With a good tent over your head, you'll ensure that you get all the rest you need to stay sharp on your travels.

english.objective: Speak with Messana Crestwind in Shen'dar Village to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
english.detail:
Mining isn't the most glamorous, but it's good honest work and a fine profession for you to explore.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Lodestone for your camp. Build one of these and everyone who wants to swing a sword will be eager to gather round your fire and soak up the extra "oomph" it can provide to increase their combat prowess.

english.title: Al'Aketh Assassins
english.objective: Kill 10 Al'Aketh Assassins in the Shen'dar Highlands.
english.detail:
You there, stranger. Get low and keep quiet. We are not alone here.

I was on patrol near the border and noticed that there are a number of Al'Aketh skulking around the house just up the hill there to the north. I don't know what they are doing here, but it can't be good.

If you want to make yourself useful, get in there and take them out. I'll wait here and watch your back.
english.progress: I wonder what they are after?
english.complete:
I'm glad you made it back. That group of Al'Aketh looked like stone cold killers. 

Thank you for your aid, I'll include your assistance in my report when I return to Valanaar.

english.title: Call of Fire
english.objective: Report to Sessaria Skystride or Aarnor Galestrike on Zephras Isle to continue your training as a Shaman. You can return to Zephras via the skycutter transport that docks in Mulgore at Skywatcher Plateau, northwest of Thunder Bluff.
english.detail: Greetings, young Skyborne. The spirits have spoken of you, and tell me that you are ready to heed the call of fire. However, I shall not be the one to start you on that Path. Return to your home in the elemental plane, seek your mentors there. They will tell you what must be done.

english.title: Fillion's Mission
english.objective: Speak with Elaadrin Evengale in Valanaar.
english.detail:
I was tasked to retrieve important data on the flow of elemental energy from the Overlook Standing Stones. That data is vital to our plans to safely travel between Skywall and Azeroth. Without that data to aid in our calculations, our attempts to steer our skycutter ships through the elemental plane will fail.

The data is likely lost at this point, and I'm in no state to attempt to gather it again. I told the Supreme Magister of your role in saving me, and he wishes to speak with you again.
english.complete:
Thank you for saving Fillion, <name>. I'm sure he told you how vital the data he was sent to retrieve is.

Without that data, our prospects for opening safe lanes of travel to Azeroth is at serious jeopardy. Our spies tell us that the Windshapers have themselves procured the means to traverse the planes, and no doubt wish to jealously guard this secret.

As ever, their own dogmatic hubris take precedence over the good of our people. They are little better than the Al'Aketh.
